category: uptime and synthetic monitoring (browser and API checks) with status pages, as code

free_tier.stated: Hobby plan at USD 0 a month, free forever with no credit card required: 10 uptime monitors, 1,000 browser check runs and 10,000 API check runs, 1 user, 6 public locations with at most 3 per check, a status page for 20 services and 250 subscribers, 1 dashboard and 10 AI root cause analysis invocations
free_tier.notes: The allowance mixes a count of monitors with counts of check runs, so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The Starter plan lists overage prices per 1,000 browser runs and per 10,000 API runs; the Hobby column shows none, and what happens when Hobby runs are used up is unverified: not stated on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-check result or payload size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: 7 days of raw data and 30 days of aggregated data on Hobby, against 30 days and 1 year on Team

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; results are read back through the public API, most routes allow 600 requests per 60 seconds, and the Prometheus endpoint is a Team feature

interface_detail: Public API at api.checklyhq.com with an OpenAPI specification at /openapi.json, authenticated by an API key as a Bearer token plus an X-Checkly-Account header; the Checkly CLI, a Terraform provider and a Pulumi provider are listed on every plan, Hobby included; service API keys are an Enterprise feature.
tooling: the Checkly CLI (monitoring as code with Playwright and JavaScript), the Terraform and Pulumi providers, any HTTP client with an API key, and the web dashboard
chaining: External HTTP, TCP, DNS and Playwright browser checks from 6 public locations against free-hosted apps, defined as code in the app repository and alerting by email, Slack or webhook.

limits.value: 1,000 browser check runs and 10,000 API check runs included on Hobby
public API: 600 requests every 60 seconds on most routes, with custom limits on some routes
7 days of raw data, 30 days of aggregated data

limits_note: Hobby has no SMS alerts (0), 1 user and no Prometheus endpoint. A check on Hobby runs from at most 3 of the 6 public locations.
binding_note: The monthly run allowances and the 10-monitor cap set how many checks can run and how often; the API rate limit applies only to programmatic management.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks for an email address or offers Continue with Google or GitHub, and the pricing page states the Hobby plan needs no credit card. The sign-up page also advertises a 14-day trial of Checkly; how an account moves from that trial to Hobby is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 7-day raw and 30-day aggregated data retention
confidence_note: Plan limits are read from the first-party pricing page and the API limits from its documentation. No account was opened, so the behaviour at the end of the sign-up trial and past the monthly run allowance is unverified: behind a sign-up.
